components.title: Amount
components.summary: Riyal amount used across cards and summaries.

sets.name: Amount
sets.description: Saudi Riyal amount: Riyal symbol (T1 icon) and the value, centred on one line. Use it wherever a price or amount is shown.

sets.name: Pricings
sets.description: Price with Riyal glyph, value, decimals and optional /yr, in 8 sizes.

components.title: Avatar
components.summary: A selectable circle showing a person or vehicle with a name and role. Used to choose who or what a request is for, such as Myself, a family member, a driver or a car.

sets.name: Avatar
sets.description:
Selectable person or vehicle avatar with name and role, used to pick who or what a request is for (Myself, family member, driver, car). Use in horizontal pickers; not for profile headers.
States: Default, Hover, Pressed, Focused, Disabled. Selected adds the accent ring and tick. Change the circle content through the exposed Slot (Initials, Photo, Logo).

sets.name: Avatar Slot
sets.description: Content of the avatar circle: initials, a photo or a logo (e.g. a car brand). Used inside Mobile/Avatar.

components.title: Button
components.summary: The main way to take an action in Tawuniya products, such as Pay now, Renew policy or Submit claim. One component covers all intents, types and states; size comes from the density mode.

sets.name: Button
sets.description: Intent (Accent, Negative, Positive) × Type (Primary, Secondary, Ghost) × Size (Large, Medium, Small, Extra small) × State, plus Icon only. Sizes follow the legacy: Large 56, Medium 48, Small 40, Extra small 32 (pill). Replaces the legacy Button, Destructive, Success and the three Icon Button sets. Label, Show leading icon, Show trailing icon, Leading icon, Trailing icon and Icon are properties.

sets.name: Hyperlink
sets.description: Inline text action with optional leading and trailing icons. States: Default, Hover, Pressed, Focused, Disabled.

sets.name: Apple Pay Button
sets.description: Apple Pay checkout button. States: Default, Hover, Pressed, Focused, Disabled.

components.title: Car Logo
components.summary: Car brand mark.

sets.name: Car Logo
sets.description: Car brand mark (Toyota, Peugeot). Brand colours kept raw.

components.title: Card Content
components.summary: Value or text block shown in the body of T1 cards.

sets.name: Card Content
sets.description: Card body value block: Points, Riyal amount, or Title + Description. Used inside Product, General and Image Product cards.

sets.name: Card Header
sets.description: Card header with optional leading icon, tag and close button; Default or Invert style.

components.title: Check Box Icon
components.summary: Checkbox square used by Checkbox.

sets.name: Check Box Icon
sets.description: Checkbox square: Unchecked, Checked, Indeterminate in every state.

components.title: Chips
components.summary: Filter and claim chips for selecting, filtering and tagging content.

sets.name: Filter Chips
sets.description: Filter Chips for search and filtering experiences.

components.title: Currency Dropdown
components.summary: Currency picker used at the start of the Currency Field. States: Default, Focused, Expanded, Disabled.

sets.name: Currency Dropdown
sets.description: Currency picker at the start of the Currency Field. State: Default, Focused, Expanded, Disabled. Currency: Riyal or Dollar (Currency Icon merged in).

components.title: Damage Pin
components.summary: Damage marker used on the Damage Map.

sets.name: Damage Pin
sets.description: Pin placed on the car damage map: Add, Selected, Done and Pending states.

components.title: Discount Tag
components.summary: Discount label for policy and offer cards.

sets.name: Discount Tag
sets.description: Discount label with optional category, shown on policy and offer cards.

components.title: Document Input
components.summary: Uploaded document row used inside File Upload: view-only and uploaded states.

components.title: Field Message
components.summary: Message under a field. Type: Helper, Error, Success, Disabled. Message is editable; Show icon toggles the info icon.

sets.name: Field Message
sets.description: Message under a field. Type: Helper, Error, Success, Disabled. Message is editable; Show icon toggles the info icon.

sets.name: Field Label
sets.description:
Field label with an optional requirement mark. Requirement: None, Mandatory (*Mandatory) or Optional ((Optional)). Label, Mandatory text and Optional text are editable.

Requirement mark is the nested _Atoms/Mandatory Mark (single source of truth).

components.title: Health Declaration Detail
components.summary: Detail row of the Health Declaration Card.

sets.name: Health Declaration Detail
sets.description: One answered detail row of a health declaration: label and value, with file, tag and tick variants.

components.title: Hero LoB Label
components.summary: LoB label pill of the hero.

sets.name: LoB Chip label
sets.description: Private part of LoB Chip: the pill with LoB name and optional icon. State: Default (dark) or Selected (light with outline). Use LoB Chip in screens, not this.

components.title: Identification Badge
components.summary: Insured person or car brand badge used on insurance cards.

sets.name: Identification badge
sets.description: Badge showing who or what a policy covers: a person or a car brand.

components.title: Inline Message Content
components.summary: Leading visual of inline messages.

sets.name: Inline Message Content
sets.description: Leading content of an inline message: percentage ring or AI mark.

components.title: Legend
components.summary: Legend of the graph section.

sets.name: Legend
sets.description: Chart legend: coloured dot, label and value for each series.

components.title: Logo
components.summary: Brand marks used across Tawuniya products: the Tawuniya logo, sub-brand logos (Drive, Vitality) and healthcare provider logos. Logos are fixed artwork, not recoloured per screen.

sets.name: Tawuniya-Logo
sets.description: Tawuniya brand logo. Type: Symbol or Logotype (symbol with Arabic and English wordmark). Color: Primary, White (on dark or brand backgrounds), Black. Do not recolour or stretch.

sets.name: Tawuniya-Subseries
sets.description: Tawuniya sub-brand logos: Drive and Vitality in their variations. Brand colours are fixed brand marks.

sets.name: Provider logo
sets.description: Healthcare provider logos in a rounded tile, used in provider lists and network search. Default shows a hospital icon when no logo is available. Provider brand colours are fixed.

sets.name: Payment Method Card
sets.description: Payment brand mark (Mada, Visa, Mastercard, Amex). Brand colours are kept as-is.

sets.name: Payment Logos
sets.description: Payment method logos. Logo: Credit/Debit Card (Mada, Visa, Mastercard, Amex strip), stcPay, Tamara, Apple Pay, SADAD. Third-party brand artwork, kept as supplied.

components.title: Mandatory Mark
components.summary: Required-field asterisk used inside File Upload labels. Candidate to merge into Field Label (Requirement=Mandatory).

components.title: Notification Dot
components.summary: Badge dot for tabs.

sets.name: Notification Dot
sets.description: Small badge dot used on tabs to signal new content.

components.title: OTP Cell
components.summary: One digit cell of the OTP Field. State (Default, Hover, Focused, Disabled) × Type (Empty, Typing, Filled, Success, Error, Missing value).

sets.name: OTP Cell
sets.description: One digit cell of the OTP Field. State (Default, Hover, Focused, Disabled) × Type (Empty, Typing, Filled, Success, Error, Missing value).

components.title: Offer Story Segment
components.summary: Story thumbnail of Offer Stories.

sets.name: Offer Story Segment
sets.description: One story thumbnail with ring, image and title; Unread or Read.

components.title: Prefix Dropdown
components.summary: Country code picker used at the start of the Phone Number Field. States: Default, Focused, Expanded, Disabled.

sets.name: Prefix Dropdown
sets.description: Country code picker used at the start of the Phone Number Field. States: Default, Focused, Expanded, Disabled.

components.title: Radio Icon
components.summary: Radio circle used by Radio Button.

sets.name: Radio Icon
sets.description: Radio circle, Selected or not, in every state.

components.title: Pagination Step
components.summary: Single dot of the Pagination indicator: default and selected, on light and dark, in two sizes.

components.title: Pie Chart
components.summary: Donut chart of the graph section.

sets.name: Pie Chart
sets.description: Donut chart with four segments, used in Graph Section.

components.title: Plate Number
components.summary: Licence plate mark used in Alshamel.

sets.name: Plate Number
sets.description: Saudi licence plate mark (brand art kept as is).

components.title: Progress Bar
components.summary: A thin linear bar that shows how far someone is through a multi-step flow, such as buying a policy or filing a claim.

sets.name: Progress Bar
sets.description: Linear progress for multi-step flows (e.g. buying a policy, filing a claim). Progress: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. Width follows the container; height 4.

components.title: Request Status
components.summary: Request and claim status indicator.

sets.name: Request Status
sets.description:
Status indicator: coloured dot and label for request, claim and policy states (22 states, including RSA).

The label follows State (no per-variant text properties).

sets.name: Claims-Insurance Card Status
sets.description: Status row for claim and insurance cards: status tag plus optional link CTA.

components.title: Review Star
components.summary: Star used by Rating Bar.

sets.name: Review Star
sets.description: Single rating star, filled or empty.

components.title: Shimmer
components.summary: Skeleton placeholders that hold the layout while content loads.

sets.name: Shimmer
sets.description: Skeleton placeholder shown while content loads. Shape: Line (text), Block (images/cards), Circle (avatars/icons). Tone Base↔Highlight pulses automatically in prototypes (after 600ms). Resize instances to fit the content they stand in for.

components.title: Sheet Body
components.summary: Small text block (number, title, description) used as content inside bottom sheets.

sets.name: Sheet Body
sets.description: Text block for bottom sheet content: optional number, title and description. Drop it into the Bottom Sheet Content slot.

components.title: Spinner
components.summary: Loading indicator built from the rotating Tawuniya symbol. Use it while content or a request is loading.

sets.name: Spinner
sets.description: Loading indicator: the Tawuniya symbol rotating through Start → Mid → End (smart animate, 750 ms, loops on its own). Color: Primary on light surfaces, Inverse on dark or brand surfaces. Use the Start frame as the instance.

components.title: Step Limbs
components.summary: Connector of Progress Steps.

sets.name: Step Limbs
sets.description: Connector between progress steps: done, current and upcoming segments.

components.title: Styled Icon
components.summary: Tinted circular icon holder used in cards.

sets.name: Styled Icon
sets.description: Icon inside a soft tinted circle, used as the leading visual of notification and info cards.

components.title: Tags
components.summary: Short labels that show a status or category, such as a policy status or a service request stage. One component; the status wording goes in the Label.

sets.name: Tag
sets.description: Short status or category label (e.g. policy status, service request status). Type: Primary, Secondary, Outline, In progress, Pending, Error, Success, Warning, Info. Status wording goes in Label — e.g. Provider on the way / Provider in service → In progress; Waiting for provider / Waiting for payment → Warning; Provider arrived / Completed → Success; Confirmed → Secondary; Cancelled… → Error; No provider found / No provider accepted / Others → Pending. Vitality and Drive are brand types for the loyalty programmes; their fills keep the programme brand colour.

sets.name: Amount Badge
sets.description: Status badge for an amount. Status: Draft, Ongoing, Warning, Disabled, New.

sets.name: Policy Type
sets.description: Policy type label used in list items.

components.title: Time Filter
components.summary: Time range filter.

sets.name: Time Filter
sets.description: Time range dropdown trigger (Collapsed / Expanded) used above charts and in date toggle fields.

components.title: Toast Icon
components.summary: Leading icon of Toast.

sets.name: Toast Icon
sets.description: Status icon of a toast (success, error, warning, info).

components.title: Tracker Line
components.summary: Timeline connector of the claim tracker.

sets.name: Tracker Line
sets.description: Connector line of the claim tracker timeline: 11 step states (done, current, upcoming, start and end caps).

components.title: Toggle Switch
components.summary: Switch track and thumb used inside Toggle.

sets.name: Toggle Switch
sets.description: The switch on its own: Selected × State. Used inside Toggle.

components.title: Upload Progress
components.summary: Upload progress track with a percentage label, used in upload bottom sheets.

sets.name: Upload Progress
sets.description: Upload progress: a 6 px track and a percentage label. Used inside upload bottom sheets.

components.title: Voice Input Mic
components.summary: Microphone trigger used inside Search Field and Voice Input.

sets.name: Voice Input
sets.description: Private supporting component for search patterns.

components.title: Card Footer
components.summary: Footer row of T1 cards.

sets.name: Card Footer
sets.description: Card footer: Full Width or Compressed button, a chevron link, or a text + arrow row.

components.title: Accordion
components.summary: Expandable sections that reveal related content while keeping dense pages easy to scan.

sets.name: Accordion
sets.description:
Expandable disclosure for related content. Use the editable header properties and place arbitrary body content in the Content slot.
Show review adds a 5-star rating row under the content (expanded only); set the rating through the exposed Review.

components.title: Balance Badge
components.summary: Balance badge on insurance cards.

sets.name: Balance Badge
sets.description: Remaining balance badge built on Pricings.

components.title: Benefits Accordion
components.summary: Expandable benefits list used in offer cards.

sets.name: Benefits Accordion
sets.description: Expandable list of Benefit List rows with an optional CTA.

components.title: Calendar Day
components.summary: Day cell of the date picker calendar.

sets.name: Calendar Day
sets.description: Calendar day cell states: Day, Today, Selected, Hover, Focus, range start/end, in range, other-month and disabled.

components.title: Checkbox
components.summary: Lets people pick one or more independent options, such as add-on coverages or agreeing to terms. Comes as a plain checkbox with label and as a bordered selection row.

sets.name: Checkbox
sets.description: Checkbox with an optional label. Use for multiple independent choices (e.g. add-ons, consent). Value: Unchecked, Checked, Indeterminate. Properties: Label, Show label, State.

sets.name: Checkbox Container
sets.description: Checkbox inside a bordered card row for list selection (e.g. choose coverages). Selected adds the accent border. Change the label through the exposed Checkbox; swap or hide the trailing Icon.

components.title: Claims Card Header
components.summary: Header of claim cards.

sets.name: Claims Card Header
sets.description: Header of claim cards: title + timestamp, with optional tag or policy.

components.title: Dropdown
components.summary: A field that opens a list of options to choose from. On mobile, tapping it opens the Selection Bottom Sheet (documented below on this page); the chosen option shows as the value.

sets.name: Dropdown
sets.description: Dropdown (Molecule). Field that opens a list of options. State: Default / Focused / Expanded (sheet open) / Disabled. Validation: None / Error / Success. Label position: Inside / Outside. Filled shows the chosen Value. Leading slot accepts a T1 icon, flag or logo (hidden by default). Message = _Atoms/Field Message, Mandatory mark = _Atoms/Mandatory Mark (exposed). Linked: tapping it opens the Selection Bottom Sheet (same page) as an overlay from the bottom; Confirm, Back or tapping outside closes it.

sets.name: Selection Bottom Sheet
sets.description: Selection Bottom Sheet (Organism, kept on the Dropdown page). Opened by the Dropdown (overlay). Type: Radio (one option) · Checkbox (several) · Empty (no results). Built on Bottom Sheet (exposed — edit the title in Sheet Header), Search Field, Radio Button / Checkbox and Button. Options in the Content slot, Confirm and Back in the Actions slot.

components.title: Expiry Tag
components.summary: Expiry date shown on policy cards.

sets.name: Expiry tag
sets.description: Expiry date marker for policy and card headers. Type: Tag (Error tag with info icon, for expired or expiring) or Text (plain date on a coloured surface). Text: the date.

components.title: File Upload
components.summary: Upload states, validation feedback, and selected-document presentation.

sets.name: File Upload
sets.description: File upload field. Type: Empty (upload prompt), Uploaded (file row with view / delete / edit), View only, Profile empty and Profile filled (avatar upload). Text: Label, File name, Helper text, Help link, Allowed files, Upload title, Name, Role, Initials. Booleans show or hide the mandatory mark, helper text, second file, upload button and row actions.

components.title: Heading
components.summary: Titles for pages, sections and categories, with an optional description, arrow button and "See All" link.

sets.name: Heading
sets.description: Section and page headings. Type sets the level (Main Page Title, Section Title, Category Title, Sub-section Title, Footer Note). Title and Description are text properties; Show chevron adds an arrow button; Show text button adds a Hyperlink (exposed, edit its Label).

components.title: Input field
components.summary: One base Input Field with Leading and Trailing slots covers text, password, phone, currency, counter and toggle fields. Text Area and OTP Field are separate because their anatomy differs. Atoms (Field Label, Field Message, Requirement, Prefix Dropdown, Currency Dropdown, Currency Icon, OTP Cell) live on their own pages under Atoms.

sets.name: Input Field
sets.description: Base text field. State: Default, Typing, Focused, Disabled. Validation: None, Error, Success. Label position: Outside or Inside. Filled shows the value instead of the placeholder. Leading and Trailing are slots (icon, Prefix Dropdown, Currency Dropdown / icon buttons, Toggle). Label and Message are exposed atoms.

sets.name: Text Area
sets.description: Multi-line text field with the same states and options as the General Input Field.

sets.name: OTP Field
sets.description: One-time password entry made of OTP Cells. Same states as the General Input Field.

components.title: Lists
components.summary: One List Item with Leading and Trailing slots covers static, interactive, entry and payment rows. Loyalty Entry List is product-specific. Badges moved to Tags, payment marks to Logo.

sets.name: List Item
sets.description: One list row for every list. Style: Outline, Solid, Ghost. State: Default, Hover, Pressed, Focused, Disabled. Title and Subtitle are text; Show tag adds a Tag next to the title (exposed). Leading slot: icon, Avatar or Payment Method Card. Trailing slot: chevron, Button, Toggle, Checkbox, Radio, Tag or Amount Badge.

sets.name: Loyalty Entry List
sets.description: Deprecated: every variant was a List Item with different content. Use List Item (Style=Outline): brand logo (Tawuniya-Subseries) in Leading, programme name as Title, ID or tagline as Subtitle, Tag (Vitality / Drive) + chevron in Trailing.

components.title: LoB Chip
components.summary: LoB chip of the policy name carousel.

sets.name: LoB Chip
sets.description: LoB chip for the policy-name carousel in the Hero section. State: Default or Selected. Placement: Start / Mid / End sets which side has the connector. The Label is exposed: edit LoB Label, Show icon and LoB Icon from the instance.

sets.name: LOB Tag
sets.description: DEPRECATED 2026-11-02 — preset of Tag (Type=Primary) that only set the LoB icon + label, with compact spacing (inset/xs, gap/xs). Use Tag: Type=Primary, Show leading icon on, LoB icon, LoB name as Label. Size=Medium had no uses.

sets.name: LOB Chips
sets.description:
DEPRECATED 2026-10-17 — Pure preset of Filter Chips (only sets Label + Leading Icon per LoB, no own styling). Over-atomised. Use "Filter Chips with the LoB label and icon" instead.

Line-of-business chips (Health, Motor, General, Protection & Saving) built on Filter Chips.

components.title: Pagination
components.summary: Compact page navigation across sizes, positions, and states.

sets.name: Pagination
sets.description: Dot pagination for carousels and onboarding. Theme: On light / On dark (the surface it sits on). Active step: 1–5. Show 4th / Show 5th set how many dots appear (3–5). Size: Medium / Small.

components.title: Payment Mode
components.summary: Payment mode selector.

sets.name: Payment Mode
sets.description: Payment mode choice: title, amount and description over a grid of Radio Buttons (Outlined). Options slot holds the Radio Buttons — add or remove as many as needed.

components.title: Progress Steps
components.summary: Multi-step progress for flows containing two to six stages.

sets.name: Progress Steps
sets.description: Shows the current position within a two-to-six-step flow. Steps: total number of steps (2–6). Current: the active step, or Completed when every step is done. Text: Now, Current step, Next step. Show Labels and Show Sub-steps toggle the captions.

sets.name: Tail
sets.description:
DEPRECATED 2026-10-17 — Unused (0 uses) — Progress Steps does not use it; a two-state progress line duplicating Progress Bar. Use "Progress Bar" instead.

Private supporting component for Progress Steps.

components.title: Quick Link Button
components.summary: Quick action button of the dashboard hero.

sets.name: Quick Link Button
sets.description: Quick action: icon button with a label, Default or Pressed.

components.title: Radio button
components.summary: Lets people choose exactly one option from a set, such as a payment method or a coverage plan. Comes plain, outlined, and as a row that reveals extra input when selected.

sets.name: Radio Button
sets.description: Single choice from a list (e.g. payment method, plan). Selected × State × Style (Default, Outlined). Properties: Label, Show label, Show leading icon, Leading icon, Show price, Price.

sets.name: Radio Button Container
sets.description: Outlined radio row with a Content slot that reveals extra input when the option is selected (e.g. "Income over" amount). Content accepts Mobile/General Input Field or Mobile/Currency Field. Change the label through the exposed Radio Button.

components.title: Rating
components.summary: Five-star rating used to collect or show a score, for example rating a service or an answer. Used inside Accordion through Show review.

sets.name: Rating Bar
sets.description: Five-star rating row. Rating: 0–5. Used for the optional review in Accordion.

components.title: RAS
components.summary: Road-assistance status tag.

sets.name: RAS
sets.description: Road-assistance request status built on the T1 Tag.

components.title: Search
components.summary: Search fields, result cells, and composed search headers.

sets.name: Search Field
sets.description: Search field with optional back, voice input and filter. State: Default, Focused (field has focus), Typing, Filled, Mic focused (keyboard focus on the mic), Listening (voice capture), Disabled. Text: Placeholder, Typing text, Value. Filter chips slot shows chips under the field.

components.title: Step Cell
components.summary: Step of Progress Steps.

sets.name: Step Cell
sets.description: One step of Progress Steps: index circle plus Step Limbs connectors.

components.title: Tabs
components.summary: Flexible tab navigation built from reusable Tab items.

sets.name: Tabs
sets.description: A flexible tab row. Add, remove, or reorder Tab instances in the Items slot.

sets.name: Tab
sets.description: A single tab item with selected, interaction, label, icon, and notification states.

components.title: Toast
components.summary: Short feedback after an action. Five intents, compact or expanded with title and actions, optional trailing text such as an ETA.

sets.name: Toast
sets.description: Transient feedback. Intent: Accent, Info, Positive, Warning, Negative. Expanded=False is the one-line toast; True adds Title and the Actions slot (buttons). Text: Title, Message, Trailing text (e.g. an ETA, shown with Show trailing text). Booleans: leading icon, compact icon, close.

sets.name: Clock Toast
sets.description: DEPRECATED 2026-11-02 — use Toast: Expanded=False, Show trailing text on (Trailing text = "ETA: 1 day"); for Warning, swap the leading Toast Icon to Intent=Warning Clock. Toast has no clock icon for Positive / Negative yet.

components.title: Toggle
components.summary: A switch for settings that take effect straight away, such as notifications or auto-renewal. Comes with an optional label.

sets.name: Toggle
sets.description: On/off switch with a label for settings that apply immediately (e.g. notifications, auto-renewal). Selected × State. Label and Show label are properties.

components.title: Tracker Tag
components.summary: Status tag of the claim tracker.

sets.name: Tracker Tag
sets.description: Claim status tag for the claim tracker header, built on the T1 Tag with compact spacing. Status: Upcoming, In Progress, Action Required, Rejected, Completed.

components.title: Voice Input
components.summary: Record and play voice messages in chat and claims flows.

sets.name: Voice Input Field
sets.description: Field for recording a voice message. Status: Voice message, Recording, Recorded.

sets.name: Chat Audio Player
sets.description: Voice message player: play/pause, progress and delete. Progress shows Start, Mid or End.

sets.description: Repair progress card. Status and Progress set the bar and the status label.
